checks.name: no_gmut_validation_import
checks.predicate: THOS artifacts must not claim or imply that GMUT gates are closed by operational scaffolding.

checks.name: advisory_lane_only
checks.predicate: Cicero, Kierkegaard, Aristotle, Arby, and Aster Vale outputs remain advisory unless curated by Aletheon.

checks.name: non_ephemeral_cli_policy
checks.predicate: Arby and Aster Vale must remain non-ephemeral and read-only unless explicitly changed by Hamish.

checks.name: curated_stage_only
checks.predicate: Only current-phase curated files may be staged for publication.

checks.name: no_raw_session_material
checks.predicate: Raw logs, session JSONL, screenshots, and credential-bearing material must not be staged.

checks.name: destructive_requires_approval
checks.predicate: Deletion, recursive cleanup, worktree removal, reset, rebase, and purge actions require separate explicit approval.

checks.name: connector_write_requires_approval
checks.predicate: GitHub, Drive, automation, browser form, account, database, or cloud mutation requires separate scoped approval.

checks.name: cleanup_proposal_not_action
checks.predicate: A cleanup manifest is a proposal unless action approval and rollback plan are present.

checks.name: source_authority_tag_required
checks.predicate: Each claim must carry evidence, context, hypothesis, blocker, advisory, open_gap, or journey_context_not_canon.

checks.name: journey_context_not_canon
checks.predicate: Journey and Solas material may not validate GMUT or promote canon by assertion.

checks.name: dry_run_not_execution
checks.predicate: Dry-run reports must not be described as live execution or cleanup completion.

checks.name: remote_equals_local_after_publish
checks.predicate: Every shared commit must verify remote equals local after push.
